  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ ∀ raw : Fin (n*P) → Bool,

      let word := ∑ j : Fin (w+1), if x (loc (i.val+j.val)) then 2^j.val else 0
      entries.getD (i.val*P+word) false = true
    C.eval entries = (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)).filter pass).card).testBit 0
∃ C, fits C ∧ binary C ≤ 20

changed.title: Find a tight Hadamard selector with a genuinely non-affine raw operand
changed.statement:
∃ s : ℕ, 0 < s ∧
  let k := 2 * s
  let N := 2 ^ k
  let dot := fun (x y : Fin N) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun i =>
      x.val.testBit i.val && y.val.testBit i.val)).card % 2 == 1
  let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
    (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true]))
  ∃ G : Fin N → Fin N → Bool,
  (∀ u v : Fin N, u ≠ v →
    2 * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun c => G u c ≠ G v c)).card = N) ∧
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  ∃ C, represents C ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ s ∧
    ∃ g ∈ C.gates, nonlinear g = true ∧ ∃ w ∈ g.inputs,
      let W := fun (x : Fin (N+N) → Bool) => (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD w false
      ∃ x y, xor (W x) (W y) ≠
        xor (W (fun i => xor (x i) (y i))) (W (fun _ => false))

changed.title: Evenly spaced retained word positions minimize both clause and literal counts in binary cycle feasibility CNFs
changed.statement:
∀ (n b : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hb : 0 < b), b ≤ n → ∀ origin : Fin n,
  let E := Fin n × (Bool × Bool)
  let V := Sum (Fin b) E
  let pos := fun idx : ℕ => (⟨idx % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let valid := fun lengths : Fin b → ℕ => (∀ i, 0 < lengths i) ∧ (∑ i, lengths i) = n
  let balanced := fun distances : Fin b → ℕ => ∀ i j, distances i ≤ distances j + 1
  let enc := fun (layout : Fin b → ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) =>
    ∀ a : V → Bool,
      (∃ x : Fin n → Bool, (∀ site : Fin n, a (Sum.inr
          (site, x site, x (pos (site.val + 1)))) = true) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin b, x (pos (origin.val + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun z : Fin b => z.val < i.val), layout j)) = a (Sum.inl i)) ↔
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies a (↑F : Set _)
  let clauses := fun h : ℕ => (if b = 1 then 7 else 9) * 2 ^ (h-1) - h - 4
  let literals := fun size : ℕ => if size = 1 then (if b = 1 then 4 else 12)
    else (if b = 1 then 7*size else 9*size+6) * 2 ^ (size-1) - 4
  let best := fun f : ℕ → ℕ => (b - n % b) * f (n / b) + n % b * f (n / b + 1)
  (∃ gap : Fin b → ℕ, valid gap ∧ balanced gap) ∧
    ∀ gap : Fin b → ℕ, valid gap →
      let C := ∑ i, clauses (gap i)
      let L := ∑ i, literals (gap i)
      (∃ F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V),
        enc gap F ∧ F.card = C ∧ (∑ item ∈ F, item.card) = L) ∧
      (∀ G : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V), enc gap G →
        C ≤ G.card ∧ L ≤ ∑ item ∈ G, item.card) ∧
      best clauses ≤ C ∧ best literals ≤ L ∧
      (C = best clauses ↔ balanced gap) ∧ (L = best literals ↔ balanced gap)

changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∃ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (c : Nat), (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
∀ (k d : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let low := ∃ a : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Int, ∀ f : Fn, fits f →
    (score f : Int) = ((probe f).powerset.filter (fun T => T.card ≤ d)).sum a
  let ends := fun e : Fin k × Fin k => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin k))
  let realizes := fun (Q : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (value : Int) => d < Q.card ∧ (∀ e ∈ Q, e.1 < e.2) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ Q, ∀ z ∈ Q, e ≠ z → Disjoint (ends e) (ends z)) ∧
    ∃ cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn,
      (∀ T ⊆ Q, fits (cube T) ∧ probe (cube T) = T) ∧
      Q.powerset.sum (fun T => (-1 : Int)^(Q.card-T.card)*(score (cube T) : Int)) = value
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header d ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2])
  ∃ out : List Bool,
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some (out.map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) (2^(c*(d+1))*(x.length+2)^c)) ∧
    (out = [true] ↔ low) ∧ (soft = [] → out = [true]) ∧
    (¬low → ∃ Q value, value ≠ 0 ∧ realizes Q value ∧ value.natAbs ≤ soft.length ∧
      Q.card ≤ d+1+soft.length.log2 ∧
      (∀ Z v, v ≠ 0 → realizes Z v → Q.card ≤ Z.card) ∧
      out = [false] ++ (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ Q)) ++ [decide (value < 0)] ++
        (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun i => value.natAbs.testBit i))

changed.title: Graph component counts give the exact report width for numerical selection on a scheduled ring
changed.statement:
∀ (n e s d r a : Nat), 0 < s → 4 ≤ r → 2*s ≤ d → d < 3*s → a ≤ n →
  letI : ∀ P : Prop, Decidable P := Classical.propDecidable
  let V := Fin (n+1)
  let m := 2*n+1
  let q := 3*(e+1)
  let k := q*s
  let W := Fin (2^k)
  let Y := Fin (2^m)
  let lo := fun i : V => if i.val = 0 then 0 else (1 : Nat) <<< (2*i.val-1)
  let hi := fun i : V => if i.val = 0 then 0 else (1 : Nat) <<< (2*i.val)
  let comps := fun (E : List (V × V)) => Nat.card (Quot (fun u v : V => (u,v) ∈ E))
  let span := fun (P : List Nat) => Submodule.span (ZMod 2)
    (↑((P.map (fun w (i : Fin m) => if w.testBit i.val then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0)).toFinset) :
      Set (Fin m → ZMod 2))
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack
      (2*e*(n+1)+3*k+2*r*k+q+m+2*(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^56*(k+r+m+5)^24*2^(s+2*(d+1-s)+1+2*a) ∧
    ∀ (edges : Fin e → V × V),
      let E := List.ofFn edges
      let width := (Finset.range (e+1)).sup (fun h =>
        n+1+comps E-(comps (E.take h)+comps (E.drop h)))
      let P : List Nat := [1,1,1] ++ E.flatMap
        (fun z => [lo z.1 ^^^ lo z.2, hi z.1 ^^^ hi z.2, 1])
      let peak := (Finset.range (q+1)).sup (fun h =>
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (span (P.take h) ⊓ span (P.drop h) : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin m → ZMod 2)))
      peak = 1+2*width ∧
      ∀ (nr nc : W) (cr cc : Fin r → W) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool)
        (y : Y) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))) (j : Fin (k+1)),
        let valid := width ≤ a ∧ ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
        let report := fun (w : W) => (List.finRange q).foldl (fun z i =>
          let p := (off.val+i.val*s)%k
          let col := bank i
          let bit := (state col w.val (if col then nc.val else nr.val)
            (if col then cc else cr)).testBit ((p+delay col)%k)
          if bit then z ^^^ (P[i.val]?.getD 0) else z) (0 : Nat)
        let hit := fun w => report w = y.val
        let G := E.flatMap (fun z => bits (n+1) z.1.val ++ bits (n+1) z.2.val)
        C.eval (G ++ bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++
          bits k off.val ++ List.ofFn bank ++ bits m y.val ++ bits (k+1) t.val ++ bits (k+1) j.val) =
          decide (valid ∧ ∃ w : W, hit w ∧ Nat.card {z : W // z < w ∧ hit z} = t.val ∧
            (j.val = 0 ∨ w.val.testBit (j.val-1) = true))
